x = int(input())
y = int(input())
n = int(input())

def gcd(a, b):
    while b:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

class Dro:
    def __init__(self, ch=0, zn=1):
        self.ch = ch
        self.zn = zn

    def __sub__(self, a):
        result = Dro()
        result.ch = self.ch * a.zn - a.ch * self.zn
        result.zn = self.zn * a.zn
        return result

    def __lt__(self, a):
        return self.ch * a.zn < a.ch * self.zn

    def cok(self):
        j = gcd(self.ch, self.zn)
        self.ch //= j
        self.zn //= j

    def sho(self):
        print(f"{self.ch}/{self.zn}")

os = Dro(50, 1)
na = Dro(x, y)
ot = Dro()

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    p = Dro()
    r = (na.ch * i) // na.zn
    z = (na.ch * i) % na.zn
    if z > (na.zn // 2):
        r += 1
        z = na.zn - z
    p.ch = z
    p.zn = i * na.zn
    if p < os:
        os = p
        ot.ch = r
        ot.zn = i

ot.sho()
</translated_code>
